print bed at z = 0, hex nut pocket facing up (no supports required)","use_orientation":"Tighten by hand around an M3 bolt axis; the M3 bolt passes through the base bore, threads through the captured M3 nut, and exits the opposite side","code":"import math

def build(p):
    # Main cylindrical body at z = 0..knob_h
    body = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(p.knob_od / 2.0).extrude(p.knob_h)

    # Cut finger-grip flutes around perimeter
    flutes = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .polarArray(p.flute_offset, 0, 360, int(p.flute_count))
        .circle(p.flute_r)
        .extrude(p.knob_h)
    )
    body = body.cut(flutes)

    # Top and bottom outer edge chamfers for comfortable feel and clean first layer
    body = body.edges("%CIRCLE").chamfer(0.6)

    # Hex pocket from top face (z = base_stop_h to knob_h)
    pocket_af = p.nut_af + p.nut_pocket_clearance
    pocket_circum_d = pocket_af / math.cos(math.pi / 6.0)
    hex_cut = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .workplane(offset=p.base_stop_h)
        .polygon(6, pocket_circum_d)
        .extrude(p.pocket_depth)
    )
    body = body.cut(hex_cut)

    # Through-hole for M3 bolt all the way through the knob
    bolt_hole = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(p.bolt_clearance_d / 2.0).extrude(p.knob_h)
    body = body.cut(bolt_hole)

    return body
